dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Michael,

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: did you see the new books I bought to trang trí my room?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I like to trang trí with classic sách,

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: but you Vietnamese people seem to prefer manga more.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Your sách are beautiful,

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Mira.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I also like to trang trí my home with sách.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: But I don't think Vietnamese people only like manga.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Many young people now đọc a lot of Vietnamese and world literature.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Have you đọc "The Red Number" by Vu Trong Phung yet?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Haven't đọc it.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I'm still...

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: limited in Vietnamese.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: You know,

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: in Russia,

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: we really value trang trí our homes with sách.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Sách aren't just for đọc but also reflect the soul of the homeowner.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: But I heard you have an entire bookshelf just about politics?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: That's...

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: special.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Yeah,

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I have a bookshelf about politics and history.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Every time I go back to America,

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I bring back a few books.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Hey,

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: if you want,

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I can lend you some English sách about Vietnam so you can understand more about this country.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Or...

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: if you'd like,

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: we could go to a bookstore together this weekend?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I know a place that sells used sách that are great for trang trí.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Go with you?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I don't think that's a good idea.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: You'll just choose boring political sách.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: And I don't need anyone's help choosing sách to trang trí my home.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I can manage on my own...

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: But...

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: where is this bookstore anyway?
